rightsEvidence.evidenceChain: OWNER_REPORTED_SUMMARY_IN_CURRENT_CONVERSATION; original dashboard transcript not independently inspected

ownerReportedGuidance.internal: Private subscribed research storage for reproducibility, audit and historical research.
ownerReportedGuidance.raw: Private raw responses may be retained, including after subscription termination, subject to no redistribution, resale or customer-facing API/data service.
ownerReportedGuidance.derived: Minimal input fields and SHA-256 audit snapshots may be retained long-term/permanently.
ownerReportedGuidance.public: Own analysis/model output described as conditionally possible; raw fields and league/federation rights remain separate.
ownerReportedGuidance.commercial: Membership/advertising not inherently barred by subscription; third-party rights remain separate.

rightsEvidence.limitation: Not human support, formal written license or legal clearance. Examples primarily covered fixture/results; do not elevate to unconditional xG/statistics publication rights.

alternatives.reasonInvestigated: Primary current-season xG missing in two predefined sampled fixtures; contingency only.
alternatives.xG: DOCUMENTED; /v3/football/expected/fixtures or fixture include=xGFixture; type_id5304 expected goals.
alternatives.shots: DOCUMENTED via fixture statistics type shots-total
alternatives.shotsOnTarget: DOCUMENTED via fixture statistics type shots-on-target
alternatives.historicalSeasons: xG page says 2024 season onward. Complete 2023/24 xG NOT_VERIFIED; calendar/season interpretation and exact entitlement require confirmation. 2024/25/current listed competitions, not account-tested.
alternatives.fixtureIds: Separate provider fixture/participant/season IDs; explicit crosswalk required. No fuzzy team/kickoff join or mixing xG scales.
alternatives.cost: Starter EUR29/month (5 leagues) plus xG and historical entitlements. xG page displays Basic EUR15/month when billed yearly; exact monthly combined quote not verified. Historical access from EUR29 one-time. Taxes/package scope extra; no purchase.
alternatives.rateLimit: Starter published 2000 calls per entity per hour
alternatives.retention: Official terms permit data storage; post-subscription/perpetual derived scope not explicitly verified.
alternatives.commercialPublicLimitations: Data resale needs approval; app monetization described as permitted in principle. Exact deployment/rights remain review-required; no automatic public clearance.

temporalGate.historicalAvailability: Must be prospectively specified before V3 research. Existing V1/V2 48h research lag is not proof that xG has been published by 48h; no V3 availability rule selected here.
temporalGate.forwardAvailability: Actual non-null prior FT feature observed at providerFetchedAt <= predictionCreatedAt; any later revision has its own observation and cannot replace a prior snapshot.
temporalGate.missingPolicy: Preserve absent vs null vs genuine zero; no synthetic xG, imputation, late backfill-as-pregame or sample selection from outcomes.
temporalGate.restAndCongestion: Arithmetic feasible from schedule; no rounding/window/boundary/competition specification chosen. League-only is not all-competition workload; first-observed fixture may have no known predecessor.

decision.API_FOOTBALL_V3_SUITABILITY: SUITABLE_FOR_CONDITIONAL_INTERNAL_ACCESS; xG incomplete in current sample and whole-season coverage unknown
decision.alternativeCondition: Reconsider only if complete mandatory xG cannot be supported after census/latency audit; Sportmonks does not currently establish a complete 2023/24 substitute.
decision.optionalFeature: xG only after full coverage/availability and missing-data policy are reviewed; no formula or performance claim
